setup_set_1.text: Barbell back squat. Sixty kilos on the bar, eight reps. Set one of four. Take your position.

setup_set_2.text: Set two. Same bar, sixty kilos, eight reps. When you are ready.

setup_set_3.text: Set three. Sixty kilos, eight reps. Brace, and go when ready.

setup_set_4.text: Last set. Sixty kilos, eight reps. Finish clean.

setup_set_4_capped.text: Last set, capped at six. Sixty kilos. Finish clean and stop there.

set_done.text: Done. Rack it. Rest starts now.

rpe_ask.text: How many did you have left in the tank?

adapt_cut.text: Change of plan. Your recovery dropped on two rests in a row, so I am cutting the final set.

adapt_accept_ack.text: Good call. We are done after this rest. Cool down and check your summary.

override_ack.text: Understood, we finish it. But the last set is capped at six reps, same bar.

strap_drop.text: Heart rate signal lost. We carry on, without adaptation.

abort.text: Stop. Rack the bar now. Your heart rate is above the ceiling. Stand tall and breathe.

session_done.text: Session complete. Check your summary when you are ready.

summary_compare.text: Against last week: volume up four percent, average heart rate three beats lower. Recovery is trending the right way.
